question: Does the fixed finite-precision public-input program recover the certified scalar on the small and 160-bit inputs while rejecting the offcurve control, with all four fixed lifts retained?

claims.text: Actual parent point order/knownanswer and predata generic finite-ring interpreter/Hensel/control facts are decided by Lean, not by this native run. Concrete target trace correctness requires subsequent Lean certification.
The three registered process records meet their fixed knownanswer/rejection and operation-count checks, retaining all four lift outcomes.

Generic p-adic/group-scheme validity, whole curve point count, compiler/execution refinement, security cost, timing/statistics, other-machine independence and matched SafeCurves/rho are not established.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact known answers; no sampling noise, variance or accepted timing claim. Repeated small preflights are in-sample instrument calibration, not A/A independence.

positive.expected_detection: At least one nondegenerate lift; every nondegenerate result2, four outcomes retained, six steps per lift. Actual small point order/relation proved in Lean.

null_population.description: One exact invalid-input control, not a statistical null population.
null_population.generator: Same small input with Qy changed from1 to2; all other public inputs unchanged. Actual equation failure proved in Lean.
null_population.why_n: Exact known rejection behavior, no statistical inference.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: Same committed source, binary, GMP libraries, flags and one thread for all calls.

factors.name: host
factors.how: No accepted timing metric; shared local host.

factors.name: public_inputs
factors.how: Each arm is checked against its own fixed known answer/rejection, not a causal speed comparison.

factors.name: lift_policy
factors.value: All i0..3 retained; no adaptive restart
factors.how: Coefficient lifts a+i*p and b+(2*i+1)*p; zero coefficient recorded degenerate, never divided.

factors.name: order_and_layout
factors.how: Exact knownanswer comparisons, no clock inference.

factors.name: randomness
factors.how: No sampled instances/seeds; every lift formula and public input written before affected target data.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Frozen analyzer compares result strings/status/trace presence; it is not an arithmetic verifier.

factors.name: preemption
factors.how: Local zero paid; watchdog15each and no retry.

comparisons.threshold: Each process must meet its own registered knownanswer/rejection check, all lift rows included.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Exact fixed knownanswer validation without timing or population inference; small then offcurve then large.

seed_derivation.note: Deterministic i0..3 lift formulas; no RNG or sampled seed. Protocol hash guards the run, not a random seed.

instance_sampling.rule: No sampling: one fixed input per arm, all written before target output. Case identity fixed; comparisons are absolute known answers only.

blinding.how: Knownanswer validation; expected scalar already certified in Lean. No fit, selection or subjective exclusions.

power.note: Three exact execution cells, one per arm. No p-value or confidence interval; alpha is schema metadata only.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Final small binary preflight0.007s unisolated, negative rejection also checked. Large target unmeasured before freeze; public bit count gives210operators per point, four fixed lifts. Conservative estimate5s/call, total15s; watchdog15s/call, hard global45s. No performance inference.

primary.name: Registered known answer or rejection
primary.definition: Small/large: all nondegenerate outputs equal fixed expected scalar and at least one is nondegenerate; offcurve: explicit rejection exit2. All four lifts retained.

secondary.name: Nondegenerate lift count
secondary.definition: Count of nondegenerate outcomes among all four fixed lifts.

secondary.name: Jacobian polynomial operator count
secondary.definition: Count from the program record, six per small lift/420 per large lift across both points. No GAE/time conversion.

stopping_rules.rule: Exactly one call per small/offcurve/large arm; each valid call computes all four fixed lifts without adaptive retries. Stop after three calls.
Watchdog15seconds each, hard global45seconds, zero paid compute; keep every failure/timeout.

invalidation_rules: Missing/malformed output, wrong result/rejection, absent trace, unexpected error or timeout makes the cell not_validated/discrepancy; never silently discard.
No postdata parser or implementation patch under this protocol. Preserve originals and use a labelled new version if needed.
Structural analyzer pass is not an arithmetic proof, independent replay or execution attestation.

decision_rule.text: Report fixture_pass only if all registered per-arm checks pass; otherwise discrepancy or not_validated, with all three rows and all lift outcomes retained.
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: integer discrepancy from known answer; no sampling inference

inadmissible: Claiming security/timing improvement or a SafeCurves/rho comparison from these counts.
Suppressing a degenerate lift, crash, timeout or failed known answer.
Giving the program the expected scalar; it reads only the seven public input integers.
Calling the unblinded preflight controls out-of-sample confirmation or independent-host validation.
Promoting producer checks to Lean arithmetic correctness or signed execution.

literature.ref: Smart HPL97-128; parent point-sources.json primary hashes/read scopes
literature.claim: First-order p-adic transfer; generic formal-group bridge not asserted by this run.

literature.ref: LMVV05 explicit author erratum; parent PCC-20261110-90623b
literature.claim: Corrected curve, fresh actual certified G/Q, old example correction already known.
Named add/double polynomials; finite-ring concrete executions checked separately, not a generic group-scheme refinement.
Predata model, trace soundness, integer Hensel identity, actual small point/rejection and analytic operation count.

extensions.preflight_scope: Small/offcurve in-sample calibration only; no large target finiteprecision output seen. Source guard requires frozen runner hash for >32bit inputs.
extensions.checkpoint_exception: User-authorized zero-paid local bounded calls; per-case/per-lift durable artifacts.
